description:
A song about a pro-wrestling match featuring Miku (as "Angel Miku") and Rin (as "Cutie Kagamine") as the faces, "Cutie Angels", going against their assigned heels, "The Amazones" Devil Meiko and Kraken Luca. Kaito serves as the commentator, while Len (as "Tiger Kagamine") shows up as the referee.

Note: The song was included on Mitchie M's 2nd album "Virtual Popstar", which released on November 6th, 2019.
